# AssetsForwarder
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/AssetsForwarder/AssetsForwarder.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IAssetsForwarder](./i-assets-forwarder.md), Context, ProtocolAccessManagedV2, [Whitelist](../Whitelist/whitelist.md), ERC721Holder

**Title:**
AssetsForwarder

Contract that forwards assets from whitelisted senders or its own balance to target addresses


## Functions
### constructor

Initializes the AssetsForwarder contract


```solidity
constructor(address accessManager) ProtocolAccessManagedV2(accessManager);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`accessManager`|`address`|Address of the ProtocolAccessManager contract|


### forwardAsset

Pulls assets from the caller and sends them to the target address


```solidity
function forwardAsset(
    address targetAddress,
    address asset,
    uint256 amount
)
    external
    onlyWhitelisted(address(this), _msgSender())
    onlyWhitelisted(address(this), targetAddress);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetAddress`|`address`|The address to receive the assets|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset to transfer|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to transfer|


### sendAsset

Sends existing assets in the contract to the target address


```solidity
function sendAsset(
    address targetAddress,
    address asset,
    uint256 amount
)
    external
    onlyWhitelisted(address(this), _msgSender())
    onlyWhitelisted(address(this), targetAddress);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetAddress`|`address`|The address to receive the assets|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset to transfer|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to transfer|


### sweepAsset

Sends existing assets in the contract to the caller (keeper)


```solidity
function sweepAsset(address asset, uint256 amount) external onlyKeeper;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset to sweep|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to sweep|
